description:
The written report on one portfolio, every figure numbered F1, F2… beside its method and
        window. In: holdings. Out: a text to quote or keep. Typical questions: 'Write me a
        report on this portfolio I can keep.'; 'Give me the numbers with their sources.'; 'A
        citable summary of my portfolio, please.'. Instead: for the full structured
        measurement, measure_portfolio (which includes this report). For a few plain
        sentences, plain_findings. It does not recommend, predict or calculate tax.

base.description: Currency code every figure is expressed in: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD… Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: number}, 1 to 100 holdings. Weights in any scale (60/20/20 or 0.6/0.2/0.2) or money amounts in the base currency (60000/20000/20000): holdings adding up to 1 or 100 are read as percentages, anything else as money, which makes the falls come out in money. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, EQQQ.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash). Example: {"VTI": 60, "VXUS": 20, "BND": 20}.
holdings.title: Holdings

name: portfolio_report

outputSchema.description: The numbered report: every figure beside its method.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

facts.description: One entry per figure: id, label, value, method, window, limit.

markdown.description: The report as markdown, figures numbered F1, F2…

receipt.description: A short plain-text receipt of the same figures.

title: The numbered report
